general_feeling: It was fun in a way, but also could feel the stares of the people which made me a bit anxious sometimes, but overall, it wasn`t bad
challenges: Due to the heaviness of the glasses, it became quite uncomfortable and hurt a bit every day. which made it harder to wear it especially by the evening. When this happened, I pushed the glasses up to my head (like you do with sunglasses) for a minute or to, so that the pain will go away. Also, quite a lot of people were staring on the street and though I was recording them, which also made me feel uncomfortable. IN these situations when people approached me, I made sure they understand that it was not a camera and explained the study and what the sensors are for
act_impact: During work, I am moving around quite a lot, I had to be more careful than usual, because I was afraid my glasses will fall off
beh_adapt: I was moving more carefully in general
social: Yes, as mentioned above, also multiple students and professors have approached me in the university, and my friends had a good time making fun of me:)
improvements: I am not sure if it is possible to make the sensors a little smaller or less heavy, so it won`t hurt as much, or won`t stand out as much.
change_behavior: I am not sure, I think I did mostly the things and look at things the same way as usual.
